name: Himegoto Union ~We Are in the Springtime of Life!~
original_name: ひめごとユニオン ～We are in the springtime of life!～
source:
Saizou seems to be a typical student, but he’s actually a ninja-in-training! Maybe destiny had something to do with it, but he met four girls who also had secrets which couldn’t be told to others. They were the blonde transfer student Himeria (who’s actually a princess), his model-like senpai Yuuki (who’s actually a heroine of justice), the beautiful swordsman Hijiri (who’s actually a girl in disguise), and his small kouhai Koharu (who has superhuman strength in certain situations). Himeria revived the local history research group, which became the ‘secret union’.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
斋藏看似是一个普通的学生，但实际上他是一名忍者修行者！也许是命运的安排，他遇到了四个同样有着不能告诉别人的秘密的女孩。他们是金发转校生希梅莉亚（其实是公主）、模型般的前辈优纪（其实是正义女主角）、美丽的剑客圣（其实是女扮男装）和小小红孩小春（在某些情况下拥有超人的力量）。希梅里亚复兴了当地历史研究小组，该小组成为“秘密联盟”。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
